{
  "summary": "The function fn_02 computes a hash of the input buffer using a custom algorithm and returns the result as a 64-bit unsigned integer. It does not modify the input buffer or write to the output buffer.",
  "proposed_name": "fn_02",
  "algorithm": "custom hash",
  "self_confidence": 1.0,
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "claim_0",
      "type": "ALG",
      "text": "Implements a custom hash algorithm.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_1",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "Uses a for loop to iterate over the input buffer.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_2",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "Does not write to out.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_3",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns the computed hash value when the input length is valid.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_4",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "Uses the constant 0xcbf29ce484222325 as the initial hash value.",
      "asserted_values": ["0xcbf29ce484222325"],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_5",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "Uses the constant 0x100000001b3 as the multiplier in the hash computation.",
      "asserted_values": ["0x100000001b3"],
      "confidence": 1.0
    }
  ],
  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\nuint64_t fn_02(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325;\n  for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n    h = (h ^ in[i]) * 0x100000001b3;\n  }\n  return h;\n}"
}
